hypotheses.feature_definition: Specific task plus a publicly inspectable free resource/result and an access or use path; unverified revenue or referral incentives do not count.
hypotheses.comparator: Same author/topic/media near-date posts describing capabilities without usable delivery
hypotheses.expected_direction: Higher within-author reach and substantive saves/shares in comparable mature observations
hypotheses.failure_evidence: Low-reach inspectable-resource posts or high-reach plain descriptions; unavailable resources; effects vanish excluding incentives/quote amplification.

hypotheses.feature_definition: A familiar interpretation changes because of concrete attributable evidence; rhetorical reversal alone is absent feature.
hypotheses.comparator: Same author/topic/media near-date direct factual statement or unsupported opinion
hypotheses.expected_direction: Higher within-author reach in comparable mature observations
hypotheses.failure_evidence: Low-reach evidence-backed reversals or high-reach direct facts; effect depends on author audience or current event.

matching_rules.date_filter_rule: Validate actual DOM timestamps; never rely on query dates
matching_rules.formal_human_review_gate: Agent observations do not become human-confirmed READY pairs

requirements: source facts and access independently verified
specific reader benefit and actual deliverable
written editorial decision with material limits
publication_readiness.goal: Confidence to publish a justified candidate, not a claim or guarantee of >10000 future views
